text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

words.gloss_range: imperative command to say or proclaim, with the quoted address as its complement
words.root_gloss_range: the aligned root bucket includes fewness and other branches, but the local surface and grammar select the speech-command value carried by this imperative form
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) opens the ayah as a command before any content is spoken, so the following declaration is heard as commissioned relay rather than self-originating speech. Its clipped one-syllable imperative form gives the opening abrupt performative force while carrying the commanded second-person addressee inside the verb and governing the whole quoted address. The recognizable public-address formula also matters: this is the same kind of instructed summons seen in openings such as 10:104, 34:46, and 114:1, while the fewness branch associated with the aligned root bucket is not locally licensed by this speech frame.

topics.headline: opening command frames relayed speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first-person statement later in the ayah is authorized relay, not an autonomous self-claim.
topics.reason: Local syntax marks {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) as an ayah-initial speech command whose complement is the following quotation, and the imperative form carries an implicit second-person subject.

topics.headline: warning made public as speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is not merely known or perceived; it is mandated as an articulated proclamation.
topics.reason: The command verb takes the whole utterance as quoted content, so the local mechanism is public verbalization rather than an inward state or unspoken sign.

topics.headline: short imperative gives abrupt force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin with a clipped command before explanation, giving the address an immediate performative edge.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a Form I imperative in apocopated form, and its first position supports the abrupt opening effect.

topics.headline: command joins a public summons formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this command as part of a recognizable Quranic pattern of instructed public address, not a private exchange.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete formula references including 10:104, 22:49, 34:46, and 114:1, while contextual evidence shows the command form commonly governs quoted complements.

topics.headline: fewness branch made locally active
topics.blocking_evidence: The local word is an imperative speech command with a quoted complement; the fewness branch of {{ar:ق ل ل}} ({{tr:q-l-l}}) is not licensed by this frame.
topics.reason: V4 lists fewness for the aligned root bucket, but local grammar and the quoted-complement frame select the speech command, so the homograph tension would overread the surface.

words.gloss_range: vocative summons particle opening the audience channel
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) turns the quoted message toward hearers before the predicate appears. The word does not add lexical content so much as open an address channel, making the coming warning interpersonal and public. Its position helps make the ayah move in beats: command, address, then restricted self-definition.

topics.headline: direct address opened before content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is summoned before the warning is defined, so the message is delivered into a live address channel.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the vocative construction as syntactically forced, and the particle initiates the direct public address.

words.gloss_range: vocative mediator that lets the following definite class noun be formally addressed
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ʾayyuhā}}) is the hinge between the summons particle and the named human audience. It delays the noun long enough to stage a formal call-and-identify sequence, and it lets the definite class be addressed as a whole rather than as a loose descriptive topic.

topics.headline: mediated summons of a definite class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the universal audience is ceremonially summoned through a grammatical bridge instead of being merely named.
topics.reason: The local construction marks {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ʾayyuhā}}) as the vocative element to which the following definite noun stands in apposition.

words.gloss_range: the definite human collective as the public addressee in the vocative construction
words.root_gloss_range: human collectivity with sociability, familiarity, perception, visibility, and contested forgetfulness pressure; the local noun remains the addressed human class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسُ}} ({{tr:al-nāsu}}) names the summoned audience as a definite human collective, not as an undefined crowd. Its nominative apposition binds it to the vocative mediator, so the later warning has a clear public addressee. The root-family pressure is useful but bounded: sociability, visibility, perception, and even the contested forgetfulness derivation sharpen why a warning can be received or needed, while the local word remains the human class. Within the surah, the address returns to a standing public frame already sounded at 22:1 and 22:5 and later echoed at 22:73.

topics.headline: definite collective fixed as addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humanity is gathered as one known addressee before the speaker's role is restricted.
topics.reason: Local syntax marks the word as definite nominative apposition in the vocative phrase, and referent profiles support generic human reference.

topics.headline: human sociability and perception pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audience as beings able to recognize, socialize, and be recalled, not merely as a biological label.
topics.reason: V4 has no guardrail rows for this root, which is not a contradiction; the local noun remains the human collective while the derivational pressures survive as bounded address-color.

topics.headline: same-surah public address returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not a fresh audience scene but a return to Surah 22's recurring public summons.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete same-surah public-address references at 22:1, 22:5, 22:49, and 22:73.

topics.headline: commanded speech aimed at humanity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural widening: the universal audience is named before the speaker's function is narrowed.
topics.reason: The word stands before the restrictive self-definition and is part of the commanded public-address formula.

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle limiting the speaker's role to the following clear-warning predicate
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) is the ayah's restriction operator. It does not merely intensify the statement; it affirms the warning role and excludes roles beyond it. Formally, its fused makeup keeps restriction while blocking ordinary case governance, so the predicate remains a bounded self-definition rather than a declensional effect. The result is central to the ayah: the speaker is for the audience as a clear warner, not as controller of outcomes.

topics.headline: restriction acts semantically, not by case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle limits the meaning of the clause while leaving the nominal grammar intact.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as a restrictive fused form whose ordinary case-governing force is neutralized.

topics.headline: speaker's role defined by exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the central boundary: warning with clarity belongs to the role, while compulsion and outcome-control do not.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the nominal self-definition and semantically restricts the predicate identity.

topics.headline: third beat controls the whole predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause moves from public address into a controlled self-definition rather than an open-ended claim about authority.
topics.reason: The source rows coherently describe the particle as governing the interpretation of the following nominal predication inside the quoted utterance.

words.gloss_range: explicit independent first-person subject foregrounded under restriction
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَا}} ({{tr:anā}}) gives the speaker an explicit slot in the nominal sentence. Because the ayah has already begun with a command to say, this first person is not an unmediated divine voice or an autonomous human claim; it is the authorized speaker inside the quotation. Its overt form matters because the restriction now falls on this stated I before the audience phrase and predicate define the role.

topics.headline: overt I receives the restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speaker's identity is deliberately foregrounded as the element being bounded.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an independent first-person pronoun and attachment evidence places it as the subject predicated by the warning role.

topics.headline: first-person shift mediated by command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary between prior divine action and the commanded human first-person declaration.
topics.reason: The opening command governs the quotation, so the first-person pronoun belongs to the authorized speaker inside the relayed utterance.

topics.headline: full pronoun rather than hidden subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause gives the speaker a full visible position instead of leaving person to verbal agreement or suffix economy.
topics.reason: The form is an independent pronoun, not an attached suffix or hidden verbal subject.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus second-person plural suffix marking the warning role as directed to and for the addressed audience
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) keeps the summoned audience inside the predicate itself. Its preposition plus plural suffix makes the warning audience-directed and beneficiary-facing before the role noun appears. The attachment evidence selects it as complementing the warning role, so the broader possibility of reading the phrase as simply 'I am for you' must be narrowed; its real payoff is that the role is not abstract but a role-for-you. Against the previous retrospective scene, the addressees are now spoken to before they become another example.

topics.headline: addressed audience carried in the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is explicitly for the hearers just summoned, not an abstract role label.
topics.reason: The word combines a preposition with a second-person plural suffix and is syntactically tied to the warning predicate.

topics.headline: possible double route narrowed to warning complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader still notices the audience relationship before the role title, while local syntax keeps the phrase attached to the warning role.
topics.reason: CRITICAL preserves a double semantic route, but attachment evidence specifically governs the suffix through the preposition as a complement of the warning predicate, so the broader attachment claim is qualified.

topics.headline: restriction bound to audience benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the transition from past third-person examples to a present second-person warning addressed before the outcome arrives.
topics.reason: The phrase intervenes before the role noun and works with the restriction to make the warning role audience-facing.

words.gloss_range: indefinite qualitative predicate naming a warning role, stable in character and completed by clarity
words.root_gloss_range: warning, alerting to danger, caution, warning-signs, and vow or consecration pressure; the local sense is the warning role, with vow and alarm branches kept as solemnity and urgency rather than replacement senses

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: clear, manifest, and making clear as the qualifier of the warning role

words.prose: {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) is the restricted predicate, but it is indefinite and qualitative rather than a detached exclusive title. The word names the kind of role being claimed: a warner whose function is stable, audience-directed, and then completed by {{ar:مُبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}). The root field adds pressure without replacing the local sense: alarm, warning-sign, vow, and advance-scout imagery make the role solemn and prospective, as if danger ahead is reported before the audience reaches it. That matters after 22:48, where an endpoint has just been named; it also resumes the surah-opening public summons (22:1), same-surah warning-sign language (22:29), and the punishment still ahead (22:57). The recurring clear-warning formula appears in places such as 15:89, 46:9, 51:50, and 71:2, so the phrase sounds like a known prophetic office rather than an isolated label.

topics.headline: indefinite predicate names role type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speaker claims the function of warner under restriction, not a self-standing exclusive title.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite nominative predicate of the explicit pronoun, and the restriction makes this role the content of the self-definition.

topics.headline: warning role completed by clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that clarity is grammatically attached to the warning role, preventing warning from being heard as opaque alarm.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final participle as an adjective qualifying the warning noun, and both words share the indefinite nominative predicate frame.

topics.headline: alarm, vow, and scout pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is urgent and consequence-bound, like an advance notice of danger, not casual information.
topics.reason: V4 supports a warning branch and a distinct vow branch; the local predicate selects the warning role while vow and alarm pressure survive as solemnity and urgency.

topics.headline: qualitative form makes warning stable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices warning as a defining characterization in this utterance, not only a one-time act of warning.
topics.reason: The input marks the local form as an adjectival qualitative pattern rather than the counterfactual active participle form.

topics.headline: warning and clarity function as a pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paired warning-clarity formula as a familiar prophetic announcement, not two unrelated descriptions.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete recurrence references at 15:89, 46:9, 51:50, and 71:2, and contextual evidence shows a strong pairing with the clarity qualifier.

topics.headline: past endpoint becomes present warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the previous endpoint and judged settlements become the reason for a present prospective warning.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah links to 22:1, 22:29, 22:48, and 22:57, all of which sharpen the warning role.

topics.headline: role boundary excludes excess agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning predicate gives the restriction its content: the speaker warns but does not control the outcome.
topics.reason: The restricted particle and predicate noun together define the speaker's bounded role, while lexical solemnity strengthens rather than expands that role.

words.gloss_range: clear, manifest, and making clear as the final adjective qualifying the warning role
words.root_gloss_range: separation, distinction, appearing clearly, disclosing meaning, and evidence-language; the local participle qualifies the warning as evident and clarifying

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the warning role qualified by the final adjective

words.prose: {{ar:مُبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) closes the ayah by qualifying the warning role itself. Its agreement and case keep clarity inside the predicate phrase, so the point is not a separate personal trait but a clear and clarifying warning office. The root's separation image gives the clarity concrete force: the warning distinguishes what would otherwise remain confused. As a Form IV active participle, the word can be heard both as manifest in itself and as making things manifest for others. The formula with {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) and the final matching cadence make warning and clarity land as one paired closure, with earlier same-surah clarity vocabulary at 22:5, 22:11, 22:16, and 22:17 gathered into this final predicate.

topics.headline: clarity qualifies the warning role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that clarity belongs to the warning function, not to the speaker as a detached personal description.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as an adjective qualifying the warning noun, and QAC marks both in the same nominative predicate frame.

topics.headline: clarity as distinction from confusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that clarity is an act of distinction, separating the warning from confusion rather than merely making it loud.
topics.reason: V4 supports branches for separation, appearance, and disclosure of meaning, all of which cohere with the local clear or clarifying qualifier.

topics.headline: manifest and making-manifest force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the adjective can point inward to evidentness and outward to clarification, both strengthening the warning.
topics.reason: The word is a Form IV active participle, and the supplied lexical evidence allows both being clear and making clear in this form.

topics.headline: familiar clarity register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final adjective belongs to a broad Quranic clarity register and to the recurring clear-warning pair.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles show a large active-participle group, and CRITICAL rows identify the recurring pairing with the warning role.

topics.headline: same-surah clarity gathered at the end
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the previous endpoint becomes perceptible through a clarity word that also echoes earlier same-surah clarity vocabulary.
topics.reason: The source rows give concrete same-surah clarity references at 22:5, 22:11, 22:16, and 22:17 and connect the final qualifier to the endpoint of 22:48.

topics.headline: matching cadence binds the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two predicate words land together through matching case ending and sound pattern.
topics.reason: The final adjective shares nominative tanwīn with the predicate noun and closes the ayah as the last qualifier.

topics.headline: warning and distinction converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the formula needs both halves: warning alerts, and clarity distinguishes the path ahead from confusion.
topics.reason: The root's separation-based clarity and the warning noun are grammatically joined, so the final phrase fuses prospective alarm with intelligible distinction.

baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative launches a voiced, human-directed hazard signal: warning awakens caution and its clarity makes the danger expressible rather than leaving it latent.

activation_trace.role: Voiced production supplies the public utterance that launches the warning.
Manifest humanity supplies the collective audience to whom the alarm is exposed.
Fear-awakening notification supplies the hazard function and aims it at caution.
Disclosure through speech or sign makes the warning's content publicly legible.

changed_reading.before: A messenger simply states that he is a clear warner.
changed_reading.after: The commanded utterance is a public hazard signal that makes danger perceptible to the human audience so caution can awaken.

baseline_models.mechanism: The exclusive construction defines and separates a commission while retaining a relation to its addressees: the speaker's office is to render warning manifest for them, not to claim every consequence of the warning.

activation_trace.role: The definitional branch of speech supplies a boundary around the office being stated.
Notification of feared danger supplies the positively retained task inside that boundary.
Separation supplies the limiting edge that distinguishes warning from broader control.
A connection between parties keeps the bounded office relationally directed by لَكُمْ.

changed_reading.before: The speaker claims a broad identity as messenger or guide.
changed_reading.after: The sentence fences a narrower commission: voiced disclosure of warning belongs to him, while response and outcome are not claimed.

baseline_models.mechanism: The warning is built as a human-facing interface: tongue-borne speech meets perception, turns toward the audience, and removes informational estrangement.

activation_trace.role: The tongue as instrument supplies an embodied channel rather than abstract information alone.
Perception by seeing, hearing, or sensing supplies the human reception point of the warning.
The side facing a human supplies the warning's deliberate orientation toward its audience.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign completes the interface between speaker and perceiver.

changed_reading.before: Mankind is a generic vocative and clear means abstract intelligibility.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a human-facing encounter in which embodied speech is made available to sight, hearing, and social recognition.

baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside ordinary alarm, the obligation and compensable-wound branches make warning resemble performative notice: delivery discharges a duty and leaves an explicit basis for accountability if harm is ignored.

activation_trace.role: Self-imposed obligation supplies the binding-duty resonance carried by the act of warning.
A wound carrying due compensation supplies the accountability resonance after notified harm.
Explicit disclosure by word or sign makes the notice inspectable rather than tacit.

changed_reading.before: Warning only predicts a feared event.
changed_reading.after: Warning may also perform notice, discharging a binding commission and preserving a basis for later accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier making-clear sequence embeds ب ي ن inside measured formation and the revival of inert earth, so مُّبِينٌ can describe demonstrative disclosure through observable transformations, not verbal lucidity alone.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure by speech or sign anchors the focus adjective in an act of making meaning accessible.
Measured formation supplies a staged material demonstration rather than an unsupported assertion.
The repeated root explicitly names the developmental sequence as disclosure for the same audience.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life supplies visible motion as evidence within the disclosure.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the demonstrative endpoint that the warning can point toward.

structural_cues: 22:5 repeats يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ and لَكُمْ around a verbal form of ب ي ن, then unfolds developmental and ecological sequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated audience grammar, explicit making-clear, and visible transformations; I infer that these processes are evidence carried by the focus warning, while the live alternative is that مُّبِينٌ only describes the warner's diction.

changed_reading.before: Clear means that the warning is plainly worded.
changed_reading.after: Clear also means demonstratively manifest: the warning points through embodied and ecological transformations that make its claim inspectable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening demand for self-protection and the later sudden arrival form a preventive interval: a warning given before surprise is an affordance for taking cover, not merely a threat.

activation_trace.role: Fear-awakening notification anchors the focus in anticipatory caution.
Explicit disclosure makes protective response possible before danger arrives.
Placing oneself in protection supplies the practical response that warning is inferred to enable.
Sudden arrival supplies the temporal hazard against which advance warning has value.

structural_cues: The surah opens and the focus both address all people, while 22:55 closes the warning horizon with sudden arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-protection and surprise; I supply the arrow that advance notification enables protective action, with juridical notice remaining a live alternative function.

changed_reading.after: The warner creates a usable interval before surprise in which the audience can place itself in protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The travel-hearing-heart sequence relocates failure from the signal to the receiver: a warning can remain manifest while understanding is restrained by blindness of inner perception.

activation_trace.role: Manifest appearance anchors clarity as availability of the warning rather than guaranteed assent.
Human seeing, hearing, and sensing supplies the reception process whose failure is tested.
Reason as restraint from ignorance supplies the interpretive operation expected of the hearer.
Hearing as understanding and compliance distinguishes reception from bare acoustic access.
Blindness of heart supplies an internal blockage compatible with an externally clear signal.
Insight of the heart supplies the missing capacity that outward eyesight alone cannot replace.

structural_cues: 22:46 contrasts functioning eyes and ears with hearts that fail to reason, hear responsively, or see inwardly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear sensory access and internal blindness; I infer that مُّبِينٌ asserts signal availability rather than successful persuasion, though it may alternatively describe only the speaker's explicitness.

changed_reading.before: A clear warning should compel understanding if it is sufficiently plain.
changed_reading.after: The warning's clarity and the audience's reception are separable: resistance can remain in the heart while the signal stays manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extended time, impatient demands, a timed threat, later seizure, and final outcome place the warning inside reprieve. The speaker announces but does not accelerate, schedule, or execute the outcome.

activation_trace.role: Definitional speech anchors the strict boundary around what the commanded speaker claims.
Advance notification supplies the speaker's bounded role within the interval.
Extension of time supplies the reprieve in which the warning remains active.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies an executor distinct from the announcing voice.
Demanded acceleration supplies pressure that the warning voice does not satisfy.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies a schedule outside the warner's control.
Becoming toward a final outcome supplies the destination beyond the warning interval.

structural_cues: 22:47-48 juxtapose demands for haste, non-failure of the promise, extended time, seizure, and destination immediately before 22:49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delay, demanded haste, promise, seizure, and outcome; I infer an agency split between warning and execution, while the alternative is that the sequence stresses certainty more than merciful reprieve.

changed_reading.before: The warner stands as the immediate agent of the threatened event.
changed_reading.after: The warner speaks within extended time: he neither controls the timetable nor executes the seizure, and the delay does not cancel the warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two verses after the focus bifurcate response into trusting action and adversarial striving. The manifest warning therefore functions as a threshold that connects the audience to a choice while separating resulting trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Separation supplies the branching threshold latent in a manifest warning.
Connection between parties keeps both divergent responses attached to the same addressed warning.
Heart-settling assent supplies one response trajectory after the warning.
Intentional action turns receptive assent into a consequential path.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer supplies the protective outcome of that path.
Competitive striving supplies the opposing attempt to defeat the disclosed signs.
Attempted escape or outstripping supplies the adversarial aim of the second trajectory.
Intensely kindled fire supplies the terminal outcome attached to adversarial striving.

structural_cues: 22:50 and 22:51 form parallel relative-clause outcomes immediately after the focus, one receptive and one adversarial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent divergent trajectories; I infer that encounter with the warning is their decision threshold, while a live alternative is that the outcomes merely follow in discourse without being caused by the warning.

changed_reading.before: The warning transfers information to an undifferentiated audience.
changed_reading.after: The warning is a shared threshold: it connects both groups to one disclosure while separating receptive action from attempted defeat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The transmission sequence moves from sending and recitation through intrusive casting to removal and securing. Clarity is thus a maintained achievement under contestation, not necessarily an untouched channel.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance anchors the changed model in the focus act of transmission.
Manifest appearance supplies the clarity that the contested process is inferred to preserve.
Messenger and message supply the transmission channel in which contestation occurs.
A report arriving and being conveyed supplies the informational payload of that channel.
Recitation placed in sequence supplies the articulated stream into which interference enters.
Casting something into a field supplies the intrusive insertion that contests the stream.
Removal followed by replacement supplies corrective repair rather than passive purity.
Securing and perfecting supplies the process that restores a firm, manifest signal.

structural_cues: 22:52 sequences sending, recitation, adversarial casting, removal, and then securing of the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contested and repaired transmission sequence; I infer that مُّبِينٌ can name achieved robustness after correction, while the live alternative is that 22:52 concerns signs generally rather than the adjective's force here.

changed_reading.before: Clear warning presupposes a channel that never encounters interference.
changed_reading.after: Clear warning can be resilient transmission whose manifestness is secured through exposure and removal of interference.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs stand beside guidance attributed to God, and later guidance is again assigned to God. This sharpens إِنَّمَا: the speaker discloses warning but does not claim control of inward guidance.

activation_trace.role: Definitional speech anchors the focus sentence as a delimitation of office.
Warning notification supplies the office positively assigned to the speaker.
Gentle direction to truth supplies an agency that the context attributes beyond the human warner.
Manifest signs coexist with separately attributed guidance, preventing clarity from collapsing into compelled response.
Repeated direction toward the path reinforces the separate agency of guidance after reception.

structural_cues: 22:16 coordinates manifest signs with God guiding whom He wills, and 22:54 again predicates guidance after knowledge and belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated distinction between manifest signs and attributed guidance; I infer that إِنَّمَا limits the speaker to warning, while the alternative is that he still guides instrumentally through that warning.

changed_reading.before: A clear warner is expected to produce guidance in the hearer.
changed_reading.after: The warner makes danger manifest, but clarity of delivery does not amount to control over inward guidance or assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same ن ذ ر root occurs in a fulfillment sequence for vows. That echo activates the warning-as-obligation branch: calling oneself نَذِيرٌ can be heard as faithfully discharging a binding commission, while ordinary hazard warning remains primary.

activation_trace.role: Self-binding obligation anchors the exploratory duty resonance inside the focus noun.
Explicit disclosure supplies the act by which the binding commission is discharged.
Completion without deficiency supplies the manner in which an obligation is fulfilled.
Discharging and fully performing a due right supplies the completion frame around the vow.
The contextual vow directly activates the shared root's binding-obligation branch.

structural_cues: 22:29 places fulfillment, completion, and vows in one ritual sequence before the focus reuses the same root for warner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a same-root vow occurrence inside a fulfillment frame; I infer a commission-discharge echo in نَذِירٌ, while the materially live alternative is that the forms are semantically separate and only B001 warning should govern.

changed_reading.before: The noun identifies someone who reports danger.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the noun also presents the speaker as fulfilling a binding duty by making the warning explicit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the compensable-wound sense of ن ذ ر and extends it through judgment vocabulary; it remains anchored in نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ and a coherent notice-to-adjudication mechanism, so downstream prose should call it a forensic resonance rather than translate warner as legal officer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ as explicit notice before adjudication

activation_trace.role: A wound carrying due compensation supplies the unusual liability image behind formal notice.
Disclosure by word or sign supplies the explicit record needed for a notice mechanism.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the later adjudicative stage.
Separation between parties supplies the disputed sides upon which judgment operates.
Performing and satisfying a due right supplies the liability-resolution step.
Judgment between people supplies the final forum in which explicit warning can bear on accountability.

changed_reading.before: The warning is only predictive speech about future harm.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the clear warning also creates a notice record that precedes separation, judgment, and satisfaction of what is due.

strongest_changes: مُّبِينٌ shifted from plain wording to demonstrative manifestness through material signs, while remaining separable from successful reception.
نَذِيرٌ shifted from a threat label to a preventive interval and a response threshold inside divine reprieve.
إِنَّمَا sharpened an agency boundary: the speaker discloses warning but does not schedule seizure, compel assent, or control guidance.
The transmission sequence allowed clarity to coexist with contestation and corrective securing rather than requiring an untouched channel.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported deliberately coexisting mechanisms: ب ي ن both separates and connects, ن ذ ر alarms and carries obligation or liability echoes, and the human-perception branches made clarity an encounter that can expose both message and hearer.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from encounter with the warning to the two outcomes in 22:50-51 is abductive; the sequence could be classificatory rather than causal.
The vow, compensable-wound, and non-dominant ق ل ل activations are visibly anchored but form-distant and should remain qualified.
مُّبِينٌ may primarily qualify the warner's explicit speech even where the context activates a broader network of demonstrative signs.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The messenger's role is bounded public disclosure.** `ق و ل B001` is uttered speech; `ن ذ ر B001` warning that awakens caution; `ب ي ن B004/B005` becoming clear and disclosing by expression. *Innamā* restricts the first-person role after historical outcomes have been displayed. I infer that the warning makes consequences visible but does not itself coerce response or control timing. The verse reads as a sharply delimited communicative office: clarify enough to awaken protective action.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:72 later paired clear recitation with visible facial rejection, showing that warning both discloses consequence and discloses the hearer's orientation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The messenger's causal role is bounded disclosure.** Fixed `قُل` activates `ق و ل:B001` (uttered speech), `نَذِير` activates `ن ذ ر:B001` (warning that awakens fear and caution), and `مُّبِين` activates `ب ي ن:B004` (becoming clear) with `B005` (disclosing meaning). `22:45-48` supplied historical evidence and corrected temporal haste; `22:50-51` supply divergent responses. The restrictive `إِنَّمَا` limits the speaker's assigned role. I infer that warning makes the choice-field visible but does not itself execute judgment or compel response. The ayah reads as a precise division of agency.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:50-51` confirm that clear warning creates a bifurcation rather than compulsion; `22:52` then shows the message itself protected by correction, sharpening the messenger's bounded disclosure role.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısındaki insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ve tek bir üyesini birlikte gösterir. Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. Evde kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp ise dal çekirdeğine genellenemez ve yalnızca kendi sözcüksel biriminde korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insan türünü ve onun tekil ya da toplu üyelerini kapsar; yakınlık duygusunu, duyusal algıyı ve insana dönük yanı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimlerdeki insan ve insan topluluğu anlamı dal çekirdeğidir; evde hiç kimse bulunmadığını anlatan kalıp ayrı tutulur ve çekirdeğe yeni bir genel anlam katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında yer alan insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ya da tek bir üyesini belirtir. İnsanların görünür oluşu, bu adlandırma için aktarılan bir gerekçedir.

facets.statement: İnsan türünü, insanların oluşturduğu topluluğu veya bu türün tek bir üyesini görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında adlandırır.
Adlandırmanın insanların duyularla görünür oluşuna bağlanması, anlamın özü değil kökene ilişkin bir açıklamadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, dalın insan türünü hem topluluk hem tek kişi olarak gösterebildiğinde ve görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfıyla karşıtlık kurduğunda birleşir. Görünürlük, ortak anlamdan çok adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak sunulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi görmeyi temel alır, fakat belirli kullanımlarda işitmeyi, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etmeyi ve çevreye bakarak birini aramayı da aynı dalda aktarır. Bu yüzden dal genel ve sınırsız bir algı yetisi diye tanımlanamaz; her uzantı kendi bağlamına bağlı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duyusal olarak fark etmeyi ve belirtilen bağlamlardaki işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma kullanımlarını kapsar; yakınlık ve rahatlık duygusunu kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Görüp fark etme çekirdeği ile ses işitme, olgunluk belirtisini ayırt etme ve çevreye bakıp araştırma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplardaki kapsam çıplak biçime genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görüp fark etmeyi anlatır. Belirli kullanımlarda bir sesi işitmeye, bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini ya da kaygı veren bir durumu sezmeye ve çevreye bakarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını araştırmaya uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi gözle görerek fark etmeyi veya seçmeyi anlatır.
Belirli bir ses nesnesiyle kullanıldığında o sesi işitmeyi anlatır.
Bir kimsedeki olgunluk belirtisini bilip ayırt etmeyi veya kaygı veren bir durumu duyularla sezmeyi anlatabilir.
Çevreye bakıp dikkatle araştırarak birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımını taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarılan anlam alanının merkezi görüp fark etmektir. Aynı ifade ailesi belirli nesne ve yapılarda işitme, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etme, kaygı veren şeyi sezme ve bakıp araştırma yönlerinde kullanılır; bunlar sınırsız bir genel algı anlamı oluşturmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişi veya şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Yakınlık ve sevinç, rahatlık veren kişi ya da şey ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvan kullanımları bu çekirdekten bağımlı biçimde açıklanabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duygusal yakınlık, rahatlık ve bunları sağlayan varlıkları kapsar; insan türünün adı, duyusal fark etme ve insana bakan yan anlamları dışarıda kalır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık, ürkme veya kaçınma duymayıp yakınlık, rahatlık ve sevinç hissetmeyi anlatır. Bu duyguyu veren kişi veya şeye ve insana alışık, saldırgan olmayan hayvana da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkıp yakınlık, rahatlık veya sevinç oluşmasını anlatır.
Kişiye arkadaşlık ederek veya yanında bulunarak yabancılık duygusunu gideren kişi ya da şeyi adlandırır.
İnsana alışık ve saldırgan olmayan hayvanı, özellikle bu nitelikteki köpeği anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, yabancılık ve kaçınmanın karşıtı olan yakınlık ve rahatlıktır. Bu durum birine alışıp onun yanında sevinmeyi, rahatlık veren kişi veya şeyi ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvanı kapsayacak biçimde genişler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin ürkütücü ve yabancı gelmemesi, tersine yakınlık ve iç rahatlığı vermesi anlatıldığında dalın çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yabancılığın kalkmasıyla oluşan yakınlık ve rahatlık bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya şey karşısındaki yabancılık duygusunun kalktığı temel durumda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alışma sonucunda yabancılığın kalkmasını ve yakınlık oluşmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: yanında rahatlık veren kişi veya şey
contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızlığı veya ürkmeyi gideren bir arkadaş, nesne ya da başka bir dayanak adlandırıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yakınlık ve güven veren kaynağın kişiyle sınırlı olmamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsandan kaçmayan ve ısırıp saldırmayan evcil ya da alışkın hayvan için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın insana alışıklığını ve saldırgan olmama sınırını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal seçilmiş kişiler arasındaki arı, özel ve karşılıklı dostluk bağını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yabancılığın kalkmasıyla doğan duygusal yakınlığı ve rahatlığı anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنس بمعنى البشر ولا الإيناس بمعنى الإبصار ولا الجانب الإنسي إلا بدليل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأنس أنس الإنسان بالشيء إذا لم يستوحش منه (maqayis)؛ الإيناس خلاف الإيحاش والإنس خلاف الوحشة والأنيس المؤانس وكل ما يؤنس به (sihah)؛ أنست بفلان أي فرحت به والأنس والاستئناس هو التأنس وكلب أنوس نقيض العقور (tahdhib)؛ الأنس خلاف النفور ولكل ما يؤنس به (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin güvenilir çekirdeği, bir şeyin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük ve yakın olan yanıdır. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı olduğu konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz; hayvan ve yay örnekleri yönü işlevsel ilişkiyle belirler. Bu nedenle sabit bir sağ-sol tanımı dalın özüne konamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya bakan yanını belirtir; salt sol, salt sağ, genel ön taraf ya da insanın kendisi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın insana dönük yan çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır. Hayvan ve yay uygulamaları bu çekirdeğin örneklenmesidir; yalnız bu kullanımlardan yeni bir genel yön anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin insana, kullanıcıya veya onun bulunduğu yöne bakan yanıdır. Hayvan ve yay üzerinde işlevsel ilişkiyle belirlenir; bu yanın sabit olarak sol ya da sağ sayılması konusunda aktarım uyuşmazlığı vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin insana en yakın olan veya insana doğru bakan yanını belirtir.
Hayvanda binicinin bulunduğu, binme ve sağma işlemlerinde insana yakın olan yanı anlatır.
Yayda okçuya doğru bakan ve kullanıcının karşısında bulunan yanı anlatır.
İnsana yakın yan bazı aktarımda sol, başka bir aktarımda sağ diye belirlenir; yönün özü bu değişken tanımlardan bağımsızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya dönük yanıdır; hayvanda biniciye, yayda okçuya göre belirlenir. İnsan bedenindeki tekil uygulamada öteki bacağa bakan yan kastedilir. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı bulunduğuna ilişkin anlatımlar ayrıştığı için genel tanım sabit bir yön seçmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yönü, ona yaklaşan veya onu kullanan insana göre belirlendiğinde dalın ortak çekirdeğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Yanı sabit sağ veya sola bağlamadan insana göre yönelmiş olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın binme ve sağma sırasında insana yakın kalan yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yanını biniciyle kurduğu işlevsel ilişkiye göre belirler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yayın kullanım sırasında okçuya doğru dönük olan yüzü belirtilirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yay yüzünün yönünü okçunun konumuna göre belirleme özelliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yüz, baş, el, kap veya hayvanın bir hedefe doğru dönmesi ve yönelmesi eylemini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insana veya kullanıcıya yakın ve ona bakan yanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin arkasında kalan, yüzünün karşıtı olan arka bölümünü gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنسان نفسه ولا الأنس النفسي ولا الإبصار.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنسي الأيسر من كل شيء وقيل الأيمن وما أقبل منهما على الإنسان فهو إنسي وإنسي القوس ما أقبل عليك منها (sihah)؛ الإنسي من الدواب الجانب الأيسر الذي منه يركب ويحتلب ومن الإنسان الجانب الذي يلي الرجل الأخرى (tahdhib)؛ إنسي الدابة للجانب الذي يلي الراكب وإنسي القوس للجانب الذي يقبل على الرامي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal göz bebeğinde görülen küçük görüntüyü, ayrıca ayrı bir aktarım olarak parmak ucunu kapsar; gözün kendisini veya genel insan türünü belirtmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın çekirdeği gözün kara bölümündeki küçük görüntüdür. Parmak ucu aktarımı bağımlı bir varyanttır; gözle ilgili belirli biçimlerden genel görüntü veya genel insan anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında aynı ad parmak ucuna da verilir, ancak bu kullanım göz görüntüsü çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
Ayrı bir aktarımda parmak ucu veya eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım da aynı adla verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük görüntüyü bir insan biçimi olarak tanımlar. Buna ek olarak parmak ucu anlamı da bildirilir, fakat bu ek kullanım gözdeki yansıma çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bakanın göz bebeğinde beliren küçük insan biçimli görüntü adlandırıldığında dalın ortak ve temel anlamını karşılar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنسان بمعنى البشر عموما ولا الأنس بمعنى الراحة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen söz kuruluşlarında kişinin kendisini veya seçkin yakınını gösterir; genel insan, gerçek evlatlık ve her türlü arkadaşlık anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin kendisini soran kuruluş, seçilmiş yakını belirten kuruluş ve yakın arkadaş adları ayrı tutulur. Bunların hiçbiri çıplak biçime genel kişi veya akrabalık anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kuruluşunda muhatabın kendisini ve durumunu, başka bir kişiyle kurulan adlandırmada ise onun seçilmiş yakınını, sırdaşını veya sürekli görüştüğü arkadaşını belirtir. İki kullanım aynı kuruluş ailesinde bulunsa da katılımcı ilişkileri ayrıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye kendi durumunu soran belirli kuruluşta muhatabın kendisini gösterir.
Bir kişiye bağlanarak söylendiğinde onun seçilmiş yakınını, özel arkadaşını veya sırdaşını belirtir.
Aynı anlam çevresindeki paralel adlar yakın dostu, içten arkadaşı ve oturup konuşulan kişiyi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, doğrudan hitapta kişinin kendi durumunu soran kullanım ile birinin seçkin yakını ve sırdaşını gösteren kullanımı birlikte verir. Yakın dost ve sürekli görüşülen arkadaş anlamındaki paralel adlar ikinci ilişki alanını genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: belirli sözlerde kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
